title: April 1st (Another Color)
paragraphs: “There’s… another spell inscribed here.”
It’s written in small letters near the bottom of the monument.
“Let’s see… Get Up Never End… is it?”
“What’s that spell?”
“I’m not sure, but I was able to activate it.”

Suddenly, a brilliantly glowing path stretched down from the sky before me. For some reason… I felt an uncontrollable urge to ascend that path. No… I can see Filo-tan at the top of that path, radiating with a holy glow.
Father let out a strange sound. I slowly took a step onto the path.
“M-Motoyasu?”
Step by step, I began climbing the path. Ah, Filo-tan.
“Wait, Motoyasu! Where are you going?!”
I’ll be there soon. I’ve only just begun my ascent.
“Filo-tan!”
“Motoyasu! Don’t go! Come back! You can’t climb that path!”
“My love is eternaaaaaaloo!”
This endlessly long path that leads to Filo-tan… Never End. ----------------------------------------------
Author’s Note! Whew, it finally ended as planned. ! The Reprise of the Spear Hero. This is the conclusion.
Thinking back, it’s been a long journey! My love is as deep as ever, and I can keep climbing this never-ending path! It’s been a year since my adventure began. A long road—
“Air Strike Shield!”
“Uwoah! !”
Suddenly, a shield appeared in front of my shin as I climbed the path, causing me to stumble and tumble down. As I fell, the path shimmered and vanished back into the sky.
“Geez… I panicked when you suddenly started climbing that thing.”
“But I’m certain I saw Filo-tan up there!” I protested to Father.
But Father shook his head.
“No… that’s more like one of those dangerous paths that show illusions and lead the protagonist to their death. Some have made it back, but… anyway, that’s not the point.”
“But according to my original plan, my adventure was supposed to end today, and I was supposed to meet Filo-tan!”
“What are you talking about, Motoyasu?”
“I’ll chant it again! Get Up Never End!”
However, that divine path did not reappear… Ugh… Filo-tan. I’ll come for you soon, so please wait for me!
“For now, let’s focus on what we need to do. What kind of spell is Absorb?”
And so, I returned to the earlier explanation. **April Fools’ Day.** -------------------------------------------------
“…So, what kind of spell is it?”

“It’s a spell that absorbs magic cast within a certain radius, as long as it’s of a lower rank, as long as I’m chanting. Father’s is a support spell that boosts all abilities, Itsuki’s is the opposite, a debuff cast on enemies, and Ren’s is similar to mine but can be converted into a magic sword for attack.”
“Those all sound like useful spells.”
“Indeed. But learning them during our stay here might be difficult… perhaps we should learn them when we get to Cal Mira Island?”
“Yeah, but if possible, I’d like to master them here.”
“Then, let’s move on. Ren and Itsuki should be sobering up by now, shouldn’t they?”
Ren and Itsuki staggered off the carriage and walked over.
“Before we enter the hotel, let’s go over the safety guidelines for the Dracia Mountain Range—”
“W-Wait… I can’t take in any information right now.”
“Ugh… we’ve only just sobered up…”
“Still, time is limited, I say.”
“Come on, I’ll listen first. Ren, Itsuki, you two rest a little longer.”
“Thank you, Naofumi-san.”
“Yeah, that helps.”

Ren and Itsuki said that as they leaned against the monument and sat down. Isn’t that kind of disrespectful? The rest of the explanation wasn’t all that different from what we heard on Cal Mira Island. The main point is that each area has its own hunting ground.

We’re currently in the central basin, and there are mountains on all four sides. However, each mountain has differences, like caves or lakes. Since the elevation changes are quite steep, it’s more efficient to stay at the lodges near the mountain where you plan to hunt.
“So, how should we split into teams?”
After being guided to our rooms at the hotel, we gathered to discuss what to do next.
“Given our current level, we can only handle the starting areas of each mountain.”
“Well, that can’t be helped. Most of us are still in the single-digit levels.”
“Motoyasu and Melty probably have the highest levels, right? We also have the soldiers who accompanied us, but…”
“Don’t count on the soldiers.”
You never know what they’ll do when things go south.
“So, Naofumi, what are the rules here?”
“Hmm… I guess it’s like the etiquette in online games? Ren, you should know. No monopolizing hunting grounds, no kill-stealing, that kind of stuff.”
“Yeah. If those rules apply here, there shouldn’t be any issues.”
“Itsuki, you’ll need a lecture on this.”
“Is there something I should know?”
Itsuki tilted his head slightly, looking a bit annoyed at my explanation.
“In the first world, I heard you caused trouble by monopolizing hunting grounds and kill-stealing, like in a single-player game.”
“W-Was that true?”
“Well, in the previous loop, you understood things better.”
Hearing that, Itsuki looked relieved and asked for an explanation.
“Then, Ren and I can explain it properly to Itsuki. A little etiquette lesson.”
“Yeah. I might make mistakes too. If Naofumi’s been observing, we should go over it.”
“What about you, Motoyasu?”
“I’ll focus on raising Yuki-chan and the others quickly to assist Father and the others with their leveling!”
“That’s probably the best. So, today’s most efficient party setup might be with Melty added, excluding Motoyasu.”
“Naofumi, you’re the one with the weakest offense here. I’ll let you take her.”
“Right. Melty, please look after Naofumi.”
“Understood.”
Indeed, among us, Fiancée has the highest level. Incidentally, before we left, she had gone through a class upgrade. It was done with efficiency in mind.
“Also, about that level cap Motoyasu casually asked about… It seems the maximum level in this mountain range is 70.”
“Cal Mira Island had a cap of 80.”
Well, if you go to an area where powerful monsters appear in an unactivated region, that limit doesn’t apply. Using it to improve abilities, this place isn’t a bad choice.
“I heard the cap in the Nosferatu Forest was 90.”
By that time, I had already surpassed the limit, so I focused solely on raising the Filolials.
“For now, let’s gather the capable ones and have everyone level up. Umm…”
Father glanced at the slaves. The older sister looked startled and nervous. She was doing push-ups earlier, but now she seemed distant.
Let’s look somewhere else. …Ah, the view here is magnificent. Thinking of how Filo-tan swam like a waterbird on Cal Mira Island, I wonder how she would react to this place.
“I want to stay with Naofumi-sama.”
“Then, Rifana-chan… I’m a little worried about leaving Raphtalia-chan with Ren or Itsuki, so she’ll stay with me.”
“I don’t quite understand what you mean, but it’s definitely best for Raphtalia-san to stay with Naofumi-san.”
“Agreed. What about the other slaves…? I’m fine going alone.”
“Ren, be careful. If you’re not, Father will complain about your lack of mentoring again, just like in previous loops.”
Father picked up on my words.
“So that’s the strategy?”
“W-What are you talking about? I just don’t like being in a group.”

“If you take a step back, respect your companions, and fight alongside them, I hear that the worries you’ve had for years will be resolved. You’ll get better at team battles, too. Your allies aren’t just distractions for monsters.”
“How much do you…? No, never mind. I get it. I’ll do my best.”
Ren looked like he was about to get angry but eventually nodded with resignation. Just then, Keel approached Ren.
“Woof woof!”
“Is that so? Then I’ll be counting on you.”
It seems Keel will be going with Ren.
“Once we’ve leveled up a bit, we’ll regroup and go over our combat strategies. We should be able to identify any problems that way.”

Ren had been particularly passionate about this point. It was something both Itsuki and Éclair had pointed out to him. Apparently, Itsuki’s advice had been spot-on and helped him grow a lot. Well, with a little review, most of the issues should be resolved.
“Understood. I’ll go with the remaining group then.”
“Once I’ve finished raising the Filolials, I’ll send them to join everyone.”
“Okay. So… we’ll meet up at the central hotel around noon the day after tomorrow?”
I nodded at Father’s suggestion. After that, we each chose which mountain to head to. I’m looking forward to seeing what kind of monsters are out there.
“Pii!”
“Alright, Filolial-sama! Get stronger quickly and support Father and the others!”
At my words, the Filolials all chirped and saluted in unison.
“I’ll head out first! Father, don’t forget to equip the armor I gave you once your level goes up.”
“Of course.”
“Everything’s in place… With the Filolials that Motoyasu raises joining us soon, I wonder how far we can go.”
“Either way, we’ll be fighting in an activated hunting ground at low levels. The enemies are dangerous, so let’s stay on our toes.”
With that, I set off for the hunting grounds ahead of everyone else.
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Hahaha! Weak! Too weak!”
“Pii!”
As soon as I arrived at the hunting ground, I mowed down the monsters with unstoppable momentum. Of course, I made sure to focus only on monsters that other adventurers weren’t fighting.

It’s basic hunting ground etiquette! The Filolials chirped energetically in tune with my battles. This only motivated me even more. Let me introduce the general monsters that appear in the Dracia Mountain Range. Albiglave Robe, Leaf Green Frog, Heavenly Blue Beetle, Shell Pink Worm. They’re all alternate color versions of the monsters from Cal Mira Island. Their ecology is more or less the same.

By the way, the monsters in the deeper areas are named with “Heel.” I wonder if it means villain instead of referring to healing magic? They’re boss monsters with dark coloration and menacing eyes. The one I fought this time was a boss called Heel Dog. For reference, in the Nosferatu Forest, it was called Fall Down Dog. The drops also varied slightly. This was something we investigated with Father. Due to factors like luck, there’s a tendency for drops to be uneven, so ultimately, we’ll need to trade with Father to complete the drop collection. While I was fighting in the deeper areas, Yuki-chan and the others quickly reached level 40. I could see them growing stronger by the second. Feeding them the defeated monsters accelerated their growth. Actually, they’re constantly hungry and keep eating nonstop.
